translations.web: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
translations.bsb: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
translations.kjv: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
translations.asv: Arise, O Jehovah; let not man prevail: Let the nations be judged in thy sight.
